feeds.title: Autism Parenting Magazine
feeds.description: Released every month, the magazine features the latest parenting news, tips and advice for parents of children with Asperger's Syndrome, Kanner's Autism and PDD-NOS. It is full of helpful advice that covers subjects like: behavioral tips, sensory processing issues, mitigating meltdowns, special education needs and getting access to services, we are confident that the magazine will become a must read for parents of autistic children.

feeds.title: The Mom Kind » Autism
feeds.description: The Mom Kind is an Autism parenting website created to help support and teach parents how to help their autistic children thrive! Keep up with Autism News, Support, and Information on topics such as school, treatments, therapy, diagnosis, home life, and more.

feeds.title: AngelSense Blog » Autism
feeds.description: AngelSense creates a safer world for individuals with special needs, with wearable AngelSense GPS & Voice-Monitoring Solutions.

feeds.title: Dr. Mary Barbera Blog
feeds.description: A blog about practical autism ABA strategies for parents and professionals. Authored by Mary Barbera, a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA-D).

feeds.title: Autism Mommy
feeds.description: Autism Mommy Therapist is a blog by Kimberlee Rutan McCafferty who gives expert advice on parenting an autistic kid.

feeds.title: Learn From Autistics Blog
feeds.description: Covers autism interviews, parenting tips, and autism news. Learn from Autistics provides practical solutions for parents and families of children and young adults on the autism spectrum.

feeds.title: Rainbows Are Too Beautiful
feeds.description: The blog is a place for Ann to share her experiences of life with her autistic and neurotypical kids and an opportunity to promote awareness and greater understanding of autism. The blog also provides light on ADHD, hypermobility, SPD, dyspraxia, anxiety and sleep issues.

feeds.title: Help For Your Child
feeds.description: Dr. John Carosso & Dr. Robert Lowenstein, Community Psychiatric Centers. Their blog shares insights & tips on raising children and teens with Autism & ADHD.

feeds.title: ChevsLife
feeds.description: Living & Parenting with Intent - Unmasking the Journey to Optimism and autism. Chivone is a single parent in the journey of motherhood.

feeds.title: Rarer in Girls...Life with my daughter Janey, who is nineteen and severely autistic
feeds.description: This blog is about Janey who is autistic and has an intellectual disability. This blog writes about the life of Janey in an honest way, one that shows both the difficulties and the joys of raising her.

feeds.title: Someone's Mum » Autism
feeds.description: Danielle Duggins. Award winning blogger, writer and autism awareness campaigner who has two children, a boy, aged five, (Biggest) who is on the autistic spectrum, and a daughter, aged three.

feeds.title: Living with a Jude » Autism
feeds.description: A little blog about living with Jude. Jude has learning disabilities so life isn't always as simple as it could be.

feeds.title: Stalen's Way Blog
feeds.description: Stalen's Way is the story of an amazing little 6 year old autistic boy who is non-speaking. His Mom shares their adventures and challenges as they journey to autism awareness and acceptance-making friends, being kind and inspiring others along the way.

feeds.title: faithmummy
feeds.description: Life with two children with autism and a mum that believes in miracles. Her journey as a Christian, mum to two very special children and full-time carer.

feeds.title: Autism with A Side of Fries
feeds.description: Living the life with a son on the spectrum who proves that a side of fries makes anything better.

feeds.title: Atypical Familia
feeds.description: Atypical Familia (formerly Autismwonderland) is a personal blog that focuses on autism parenting, family travel, working mom life & more.

feeds.title: Faith, Hope, and Love...With Autism
feeds.description: Faith, Hope, and Love...With Autism is a blog by Lisa Reyes who shares her experience of raising a kid with autism and his journey towards autism recovery.

feeds.title: Keeping Up With Kya
feeds.description: My name is Jennifer Dunn, I am the mother of a 10-year old girl with Autism. This blog is about my daughter, Kya, who has Autism. I share the real and raw side of living this life.

feeds.title: Confessions of An Asperger's Mom
feeds.description: This Autism/Aspergers community support page is a place to share information, celebrate victories, vent, whine, wine, cry and most of all laugh with others who are on the same journey.

feeds.title: A diary of a mom
feeds.description: A blog by Jess, a mother, intersectional advocate, believer in the power of community.

feeds.title: My Boy With Autism
feeds.description: I blog about my life with my child who has autism, severe learning difficulties and a suspected undiagnosed genetic disorder.Born in 2002, he has become so much more than just the label.

feeds.title: Rhema's Hope
feeds.description: Stories about life with Rhema and Hope and what God is teaching us on the journey.

feeds.title: Quirks and Chaos
feeds.description: My adventures and thoughts as I mother my two youngest children. They are the youngest of seven and both have special needs: a boy with autism and an adopted little girl with Fetal Alcohol Syndrome and ADHD.

feeds.title: Parenting Autism in Adelaide
feeds.description: Hi! I am Ryan, a 37-year-old dad of 2 from Adelaide Australia, my son is 5 with non-verbal Autism and Global Delay. My blog is about him, and parenthood in general. This blog is about the journey that is not just about being a father to an Autistic child.

feeds.title: Finding My Kid
feeds.description: Finding My Kid is a blog by a parent of a kid with autism. In this blog, you will see how Martin is overcoming autism with his determination and will and with the support of his parents.

feeds.title: Rain Momm Blog
feeds.description: Why RainMomm? I chose that name for my blog because 27 years ago when my son was diagnosed the movie Rain Man was the baseline most people had about autism. My blog gives me the opportunity to share my experiences with others on the same journey as we navigate years of advocating and understanding together.

feeds.title: Autism adventures with Alyssa Blog
feeds.description: Our family's journey with autism. An honest view into living with severe autism, the heartache, the joy, and everything in between. Join us on this adventure of autism, love, and chaos.

feeds.title: Autism Speaks Blog
feeds.description: Autism Speaks is dedicated to advancing research into causes and better treatments for autism spectrum disorders and related conditions both through direct funding and collaboration, increasing understanding and acceptance of autism spectrum disorders and working toward solutions for the needs of individuals with autism and their families across the spectrum and lifespan through advocacy and support.

feeds.title: Livebeyondautism
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Stacey-Ann, a wife, and the mother of two kids. This is my blog where I love sharing my day-to-day life as a mom. Brad is my youngest he was diagnosed with autism spectrum and is currently very verbal. Here on my blog, I share stories of our everyday lives, the highs, the lows, and everything in between.
